given: the set of sprint-1 stock rows present before the migration
then: every one of those stock rows is still present afterward with no rows lost

independence.rationale: AC4 concerns how a nonconforming row's columns are filled; this adds the distinct outcome that the full row population survives regardless of whether any given code conformed

architectural_notes: Infra layer: a data-preservation contract on the whole migration, directly realizing R1 (existing stock survives every schema change). The up-migration is additive-then-transform-then-drop with no row deletes, so the pre-migration row count equals the post-migration count. Owner module: the Alembic migration. Data-integrity cross-cutting concern. Verified by a real-branch test that seeds a known set of sprint-1 rows, upgrades, and asserts every row is still present.
